description: Wire up inactive quest and mastery bonuses that are defined in QuestData/MasteryData but not consumed: (1) Sprinting quest bonus = player walkspeed multiplier, (2) CoinCollector quest bonus = coin earning multiplier, (3) Mastery FasterRunning = walkspeed multiplier, (4) Mastery BetterLuck = egg luck multiplier. Also ensure all quest stat tracking (earnCoins, hatchEggs, destroyDestructibles, playtime, reachLevel, goldenPetsConverted) is firing correctly.
steps: 1. WALKSPEED WIRING: In Main.server.lua, add a function applyWalkSpeedBuffs(player) that: (a) gets base walkspeed (16), (b) multiplies by Sprinting quest bonus via QuestService.getUpgradeBonus(player, 'Sprinting') if > 0, (c) multiplies by FasterRunning mastery bonus via MasteryService.getBuffBonus(player, 'FasterRunning') if > 0, (d) multiplies by ShopService speed potion buff via ShopService.getShopMultiplier(player, 'speed') if > 1, (e) sets player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = finalSpeed. Call this function: on CharacterAdded (after Humanoid loads), on UpgradeUpdated (when quests complete), on MasteryUpdated (when mastery purchased), and on ShopBuffsUpdated. Also add a periodic task (every 5s) that refreshes walkspeed for all players to handle buff expiration.

2. COIN MULTIPLIER WIRING: In CurrencyService.addCoins, after existing LuckyDrops/DropCloner bonuses, also apply CoinCollector quest bonus. Get it via UpgradeService.getUpgradeBonus(player, 'CoinCollector') - if > 0 multiply finalAmount by it. Also apply Mastery MoreCoins bonus via the existing LuckyDrops mapping (which already maps to MoreCoins mastery in UpgradeService) - verify this path works. The existing applyBonuses function handles LuckyDrops which maps to MoreCoins mastery via UpgradeService. Add CoinCollector as a separate multiplier.

3. EGG LUCK WIRING (BetterLuck mastery): In PetService.lua weightedRandomPet function, the LuckyEggs bonus is already applied. Add BetterLuck mastery bonus: get MasteryService.getBuffBonus(player, 'BetterLuck') and multiply the weight boost for non-common pets by this additional factor. Need to pass MasteryService reference to PetService (add setMasteryService or pass during init).

4. QUEST STAT TRACKING VERIFICATION: Confirm all stat types fire correctly: destroyDestructibles (ZoneService fires this on destructible death), hatchEggs (EggService fires this), earnCoins (ZoneService fires this on coin drops), playtime (Main.server periodic + on PlayerRemoving), reachLevel (set on join and on level-up - verify level-up path fires QuestService.setStat), goldenPetsConverted (Main.server fires after ConvertToGoldenPet success). Check that XP/level-up path in ZoneService or wherever XP is awarded also calls QuestService.setStat('reachLevel', newLevel).

5. Verify XP level-up fires setStat: Search for where level is incremented. If it happens in ZoneService (XP award on destroy), ensure that after level-up, QuestService.setStat(player, 'reachLevel', newLevel) is called and MasteryService.awardMasteryPoint(player) is called.
acceptance_criteria: Player walkspeed is modified based on Sprinting quest level, FasterRunning mastery level, and ShopService speed potion
CoinCollector quest bonus multiplies coins earned from drops
BetterLuck mastery bonus improves egg hatch rarity chances
All six quest stat types are being tracked (destroyDestructibles, hatchEggs, earnCoins, playtime, reachLevel, goldenPetsConverted)
